zh-CN.agentIntro: 请仅实现下列当前已校验的方案。原始表达仅作参考；未支持的要求须另行确认。
zh-CN.adjustments: 用户调整与初始意图的差异
zh-CN.accepted: 已确认，以当前参数为准
zh-CN.notAccepted: 尚未确认，暂不可导出方案
zh-CN.accessibility: 尊重减少动态效果设置，关闭非必要位移或扩散；保留键盘焦点与触摸操作。

assumptions.preview-target-default: 目标未指定，使用配方的示例组件
assumptions.preset-parameters: 参数来自可调整的产品配方，不是行业标准
assumptions.inferred-motion-speed: 速度没有直接的原文依据
assumptions.inferred-target: 目标没有直接的原文依据
assumptions.inferred-trigger: 交互采用默认值或推断

unresolved.target-ambiguous: 涉及多个目标，请选择这次要预览的组件
unresolved.trigger-ambiguous: 交互不明确，请选择目标和触发方式
unresolved.glow-contradiction: 同时要求发光和不发光，请修正理解
unresolved.unsupported-interaction: 当前配方不支持这个目标与交互，可继续查独立效果
unresolved.shadow-not-configurable: 现有模板没有可调阴影参数，这一项尚未编译
unresolved.bounce-not-supported: 当前预览不含弹簧或弹跳，此项尚未编译
unresolved.composition-not-supported: 暂不支持多渲染器叠加
unresolved.numeric-request-not-mapped: 原文中的精确数值请在参数面板手动设置

conflicts.glow-forbidden: 当前参数启用了原本禁止的发光
conflicts.strong-glow-forbidden: 聚光强度超过原先约束
conflicts.scale-forbidden: 当前参数使用了原本禁止的缩放
conflicts.large-motion-forbidden: 位移或缩放超过原先约束
conflicts.stronger-than-intent: 反馈比初始意图更明显

en.agentIntro: Implement only the validated plan below. Original wording is reference; confirm unsupported requests separately.
en.accessibility: Respect reduced motion: disable nonessential movement or spreading. Preserve keyboard focus and touch behavior.

assumptions.preview-target-default: Target unspecified; using the recipe sample component
assumptions.preset-parameters: Parameters are adjustable product presets, not industry standards
assumptions.inferred-motion-speed: Speed has no direct source evidence
assumptions.inferred-target: Target has no direct source evidence
assumptions.inferred-trigger: Interaction is a default or inference

unresolved.target-ambiguous: Multiple targets: choose one component to preview
unresolved.trigger-ambiguous: Interaction unclear: choose target and trigger
unresolved.glow-contradiction: Glow is both requested and forbidden; resolve the intent
unresolved.unsupported-interaction: No recipe supports this target/interaction; browse individual effects
unresolved.shadow-not-configurable: Shadow is not configurable in this template; this request is not compiled
unresolved.bounce-not-supported: Preview does not implement spring or bounce; this request is not compiled
unresolved.composition-not-supported: Multiple renderer composition is not supported
unresolved.numeric-request-not-mapped: Set exact numbers from the original wording in the parameter panel

conflicts.glow-forbidden: Current parameters enable previously forbidden glow
conflicts.scale-forbidden: Current parameters use previously forbidden scale
conflicts.large-motion-forbidden: Movement or scale exceeds the initial constraint
conflicts.stronger-than-intent: Feedback is stronger than the initial intent

ja.agentIntro: 以下の検証済み方案だけを実装。原文は参考で、未対応の要望は別途確認してください。
ja.accepted: 確認済み。現在の値を優先
ja.notAccepted: 未確認。方案の書き出しを停止
ja.accessibility: 動きを減らす設定で不要な移動・拡散を停止。キーボードフォーカスとタッチを維持。

assumptions.preview-target-default: 対象未指定。配方の見本を使用
assumptions.preset-parameters: 調整可能な製品初期値。業界標準ではありません
assumptions.inferred-trigger: 操作は初期値または推定

unresolved.target-ambiguous: 複数の対象。今回の対象を選択
unresolved.trigger-ambiguous: 操作が不明。対象と操作を選択
unresolved.glow-contradiction: 発光の要望と禁止が競合。意図を修正
unresolved.unsupported-interaction: この対象・操作の配方は未対応。単独の効果を検索できます
unresolved.shadow-not-configurable: このテンプレートの影は調整不可。この要望は未対応
unresolved.composition-not-supported: 複数レンダラーの合成は未対応
unresolved.numeric-request-not-mapped: 原文の数値はパネルで手動設定

conflicts.strong-glow-forbidden: 光の強さが初期制約を超過
conflicts.large-motion-forbidden: 移動・拡縮が制約を超過
conflicts.stronger-than-intent: 初期意図より強い反応

ko.agentIntro: 아래 검증된 계획만 구현하세요. 원문은 참고이며 미지원 요청은 별도로 확인하세요.
ko.accessibility: 모션 감소 설정에서는 불필요한 이동과 확산을 끄고 키보드 포커스와 터치를 유지하세요.

assumptions.preset-parameters: 조절 가능한 제품 기본값이며 업계 표준이 아닙니다

unresolved.target-ambiguous: 여러 대상: 미리 볼 컴포넌트 선택
unresolved.glow-contradiction: 발광 요청과 금지가 충돌합니다. 의도를 수정하세요
unresolved.unsupported-interaction: 이 대상과 상호작용은 미지원입니다. 개별 효과를 찾아보세요
unresolved.shadow-not-configurable: 이 템플릿의 그림자는 조절할 수 없어 이 요청은 미지원입니다
unresolved.bounce-not-supported: 현재 미리보기는 스프링이나 튕김을 지원하지 않습니다
unresolved.numeric-request-not-mapped: 원문의 정확한 수치는 패널에서 직접 설정하세요

conflicts.large-motion-forbidden: 이동 또는 크기 변경이 제약 초과

de.agentIntro: Nur den unten validierten Plan umsetzen. Originaltext ist Referenz; nicht unterstützte Wünsche separat klären.
de.accessibility: Reduzierte Bewegung respektieren: unnötige Bewegung und Ausbreitung abschalten; Tastaturfokus und Touch erhalten.

unresolved.trigger-ambiguous: Interaktion unklar: Ziel und Auslöser wählen
unresolved.glow-contradiction: Leuchten zugleich gewünscht und verboten; Absicht klären
unresolved.unsupported-interaction: Keine passende Vorlage; einzelne Effekte bleiben verfügbar
unresolved.shadow-not-configurable: Schatten nicht konfigurierbar; dieser Wunsch ist nicht umgesetzt
unresolved.numeric-request-not-mapped: Genaue Zahlen aus dem Original im Parameterpanel einstellen
